newsitem.title: USA: Colombia rice tender results due next week - trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia rice tender results due next week - trade.

text.p: Results are expected early next week on Colombia's tender for 45,000 tonnes of rice, U.S. rice traders and exporters said.
"It is going to be Monday or Tuesday before there is an award," a rice merchandiser said.
An exporter with an agent in Colombia also said a purchase decision would not be made until next week.
Colombia tendered Thursday for 45,000 tonnes of rice for prompt shipment. U.S. rice traders said the rice would come from the U.S. or Argentina.
Argentina's rice is cheaper, but U.S. rice is competitive because it can be shipped quicker and at lower freight costs, U.S. traders said.
The 45,000-tonne tender was announced soon after the Colombian government on Wednesday approved licenses to import 140,000 tonnes of rice.
